sources.title: Introducing gpt-oss — August 5, 2025
sources.evidence: Dated original release announces gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b as OpenAI open-weight models, licensed under Apache 2.0. Its architecture table rounds this exact model to 117B total and 5.1B active parameters.

sources.title: Pinned gpt-oss-120b checkpoint card
sources.evidence: Names the exact gpt-oss-120b model and gpt-oss series; identifies the Apache-2.0 license, low/medium/high reasoning effort, Harmony formatting, native function calling, and MXFP4 MoE weights.

sources.title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card — original report
sources.evidence: OpenAI report dated August 5, 2025. Table 1 reports 116.83B total and 5.13B active for 120b; active includes unembedding but excludes embeddings. It identifies text-only autoregressive MoE Transformers, 36 layers, top-four routing among 128 experts, learned attention sinks, and 131,072-token context.

sources.title: Pinned Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Exact model dimensions: hidden/intermediate 2880, 36 layers, 128 experts and 4 selected, 64 query heads and 8 KV heads of width 64, vocabulary 201088, untied embeddings, attention biases, alternating full/sliding attention, 131072 maximum positions. MoE quantization is MXFP4.

sources.title: Pinned original inference configuration
sources.evidence: Original checkpoint independently specifies the same model dimensions, four selected experts, 128-token sliding window and 32x RoPE scaling from a 4096-token initial context.

sources.title: Pinned official PyTorch reference model
sources.evidence: Defines every learned module: independent input embedding/output projection, 36 attention/MoE blocks, attention projections and biases, per-head learned sinks, RMSNorm scales, router weights/biases, expert weights/biases and final norm. Output projection has no bias. RoPE, attention scale and SwiGLU constants are computed rather than learned.

sources.title: Pinned official MXFP4 checkpoint loader
sources.evidence: Maps each original expert weight to blocks plus scales and reconstructs 32 FP4 values from 16 packed U8 bytes. Shared exponent scales decode the packed weights; they are not extra learned parameters. Expert biases and remaining model tensors load directly.

sources.title: Pinned complete original checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Lists all 543 stored tensors across seven original-format shards, with 65,248,815,744 tensor-data bytes. All seven shard headers were fetched with bounded HTTP 206 ranges, covering exactly the index keys, with no duplicate keys; reconstructed logical shapes match all 471 reference-model parameters. No weight payloads were downloaded.

sources.title: Jalapeño first results — August 25, 2026
sources.evidence: Later first-party engineering article explicitly benchmarks GPT-OSS 120B and discusses its attention and mixture-of-experts blocks. It supplies no replacement model parameter count; its chip architecture and hardware performance figures are not model specifications.

name.note: Use the developer’s exact model name.

developer.note: Original announcement and official checkpoint owner agree.

family.note: The release identifies the gpt-oss series.

release_date.note: Original public release date; the later arXiv upload and hardware article are not model releases.

open_weights.note: The official public checkpoint exposes the complete model; all original shard headers were accessible.

license.note: Verified from this exact checkpoint’s license file and card.

parameters_b.note: Complete logical checkpoint count: 116,829,156,672 learned parameters. With H=I=2880, V=201088, L=36, E=128, Q=4096 and K=512, total = 2VH + H + L[(Q+2K)H+(Q+2K)+HQ+H+64+2H+EH+E+E(3HI+3I)]. This includes both untied embedding matrices, all attention/router/expert weights and biases, 73 RMSNorm vectors and 36×64 learned sinks. All 471 logical tensor shapes match the full seven-shard index. Each U8 expert block element expands into two weights; 72 quantization-scale tensors add no parameters. Fixed RoPE/activation constants add none. The exact result rounds to the original report’s 116.83B, rather than the name-derived 120B.

active_parameters_b.note: Official nominal per-token active count from Table 1 of the original report, which includes unembedding and excludes input embeddings. Top-four routing selects four of 128 experts in each layer. Derived corroboration from the fully reconciled checkpoint is 116,829,156,672 − 579,133,440 − (124/128 × 114,701,598,720) = 5,132,849,472, which rounds to the published 5.13B. This reconstruction is not an official exact count; the stored value retains the report’s precision. It is a per-token forward-pass count, not batch-wide expert coverage or checkpoint storage.

architecture.note: Decoder-only autoregressive Transformer with 36 MoE layers and top-four routing among 128 experts per layer. GQA uses 64 query heads and eight KV heads; full and 128-token local attention alternate. Includes learned attention sinks and YaRN RoPE. The later article independently names GPT-OSS attention/MoE blocks; hardware architecture is not transferred to this field.

context_window.note: Exact configured maximum position count, corroborated by the report; the 4096 initial RoPE length is not the deployed context limit.

modalities.note: The report explicitly describes text-only models; the released model has token embedding and vocabulary output modules without image/audio encoders or decoders.

reasoning.note: Official checkpoint supports adjustable low, medium and high reasoning effort using Harmony-formatted messages.

tool_call.note: Trained function/tool calling in Harmony, including browser and Python tool interactions. The host executes tools; model support does not imply built-in external execution.

description.value: Open-weight text reasoning model with 36 MoE layers, four active experts per token, and support for function calling.
description.note: Replaces broad controllability/agent positioning with supported architecture and capabilities.

patch.name: gpt-oss-120b
patch.description: Open-weight text reasoning model with 36 MoE layers, four active experts per token, and support for function calling.
patch.notes: Total is the complete logical checkpoint count, including untied embeddings, learned norms/sinks and all biases; MXFP4 packing and quantization scales do not add parameters. The official nominal 5.13B active count follows OpenAI’s per-token convention: four experts per layer and output head included, input embeddings excluded. Harmony formatting is required for the documented reasoning and tool behavior.

summary: Verified all 14 fields for the exact gpt-oss-120b release. Corrected the name-derived 120B to a complete 116.829156672B checkpoint count and added the official nominal 5.13B active count with its explicit embedding convention; added Apache-2.0 and MoE architecture, precise name and factual description. Every original shard header and all configured learned modules reconcile. Launch date, context, text modalities, reasoning and tool calling are confirmed; no fields remain unresolved.
